$comment: Curated map: skill/MCP/agent → departments. Edited by humans and by scripts/sync.mjs (entries with auto:true were assigned automatically — review them). skill-registry.md is generated from this file.

code-review.when: Review the diff for correctness bugs before declaring done

security-review.when: Security review of pending changes (auth, input, secrets, dependencies)

run.when: Launch the app and see the change working

update-config.when: settings.json, permissions, env, Claude Code configuration

skill-creator.when: Create or improve a skill, including project skills generated by Waymark

claude-api.when: Code that calls the Claude / Anthropic API

Explore.when: More than 3 locations to search or unclear scope

Plan.when: L3 tasks, multi-layer features, shared/core changes

claude-code-guide.when: Questions about Claude Code, hooks, MCP, SDK

ui-build.when: Build new UI (component, screen, modal, form, dashboard) with an intentional design direction; follows the project design system

ui-refine.when: Improve existing UI by mode: critique, polish, simplify, clarify, harden, adapt, animate, boldify/quieten

ui-system.when: Design system and visual identity: discover/record tokens, palette, typography, theming, charts, consistency check

ui-audit.when: Audit UI code against WCAG 2.2 AA and interface rules; findings with rule id and file:line

browser-verify.when: Verify a change in a real browser: smoke, states, responsive, console errors, screenshots

library-docs.when: Version-specific docs before using a library API: angular-cli MCP for Angular, primeng MCP for PrimeNG, context7 for the rest

context7.when: Docs for every library without a dedicated MCP (resolve-library-id → query-docs). Use via library-docs

engram.when: search what was learned (engram search / mem_search) before re-reading context; the end-of-turn hook saves each Aprendido (docs/adr/0015)

angular-cli.when: Angular: search_documentation (official docs), get_best_practices, find_examples, ai_tutor, list_projects, onpush_zoneless_migration. Use via library-docs

primeng.when: PrimeNG: search, list, get_component, get_example, get_guide, get_setup, validate_usage, version. Use via library-docs
